finding.claim: Client-supplied 'provider' header is copied into AuthenticatedUser.Provider unconditionally when trusted-header auth is configured, letting a caller set Provider='system' and bypass the required-justification check.
finding.source: HTTP request header 'provider' (attacker-controlled), plus any username via the configured trusted username header
finding.sink: executor.IsSystemExecution (justification.go:26-31) via api_justification.go:30-31 justificationProvided, gating api.go:161 StartAction

trace.note: provider header read with no trust check
user returned because Username is non-empty

finding.guards_checked: Auth chain stops only on non-empty username, so header path is not skipped. IsSystemExecution requires Provider==system; no server-side restriction on the value. Impact limited because the username header already allows impersonation in trusted-header mode; the extra gain is bypassing justification. Config-dependent: requires AuthHttpHeaderUsername set. Not verified dynamically.

finding.claim: Webhooks with empty or 'none' authType accept any request, and the action then runs as synthetic user 'webhook' under DefaultPermissions.Exec (default true), so the webhook is an unauthenticated trigger.
finding.source: Unauthenticated HTTP request to webhook endpoint
finding.sink: executor.ExecRequest via webhooks/handler.go:172, running the action

trace.note: empty or none authType returns verifier that always true

finding.guards_checked: HMAC-SHA256/SHA1 use hmac.Equal; bearer and basic use ConstantTimeCompare; arguments filtered to defined names and type-validated. Gap is the open default when authType is unset. Config-dependent.

finding.claim: RestartAction re-executes another user's stored run by tracking ID, reusing the stored justification and non-password arguments, gated only by the caller's exec permission (no owner or logs check on the source entry).
finding.source: RestartActionRequest.ExecutionTrackingId (client-supplied at start, api.go:167) of a run owned by another user
finding.sink: executor.ExecRequest with stored Arguments and Justification (api.go:1661-1669)

trace.note: GetLog by tracking ID with no owner or view check

finding.guards_checked: Exec ACL enforced. Password args not persisted (log_arguments.go:99-104), so not replayed. Restarter cannot read original output. Impact is audit attribution and cross-user replay, not direct escalation to secrets.

finding.claim: anchorCustomRegexPattern returns a pattern unchanged if it starts with '^' and ends with '$', so top-level alternation like '^foo|bar$' is not anchored and accepts partial matches.
finding.source: Client argument value for a 'regex:' typed argument
finding.sink: regexp.MatchString validation at arguments.go:341 for exec-mode argv

trace.note: anchorCustomRegexPattern returns pattern unchanged when ^ and $ present

finding.guards_checked: regex: types rejected for shell actions (arguments.go:381-388), so exec-mode only and admin-authored pattern required. Low severity.

finding.claim: Identifier types allow a leading '-', so a client value can be interpreted as an option by an exec-mode target program that lacks a '--' terminator.
finding.source: Client argument value starting with '-' for shell_safe_identifier/unicode_identifier/ascii_identifier

trace.note: argv passed without shell, positional element

finding.guards_checked: No shell injection: exec uses argv slice, not sh -c. Impact requires admin exec template with positional arg and no '--'. Informational/low.
